name: Fixed-RealRun-Mi355x-20261030
speculative_decoding: mtp (DSPARK block 5, 6 draft tokens, real acceptance)
workload: Cached cases: every request shares one random C-token prefix (C = 131072 or 262144) and adds its own E random tokens (E = 512, 1024, 2048 or 4096); ISL = C + E. Token-id prompts, so TTFT excludes tokenization. Each pass sends 2 x concurrency warm-up requests, then 10 x concurrency measured requests at unlimited rate, ignore-EOS, temperature 0. Every measured prefill batch reported exactly C cached tokens per new request. Cold cases: radix cache off, the whole ISL = C is prefilled; E is recorded as ISL, following the simulator convention.

server_families.tp2-adp1: TP2 EP1, max-running-requests 64, mem-fraction-static 0.8, prefill-decode-interval 32, swa-prefix-tails 2048
server_families.tp4-adp1: TP4 EP1, max-running-requests 32, mem-fraction-static 0.7, prefill-decode-interval 96, swa-prefix-tails 1024
server_families.shared: dsv4 attention with flashmla, fp8_e4m3 KV cache, page size 256, chunked-prefill and max-prefill tokens 16384, CUDA graph on, fcfs; merge-conc: one server per TP family and workload, launched with that family's highest-concurrency override (TP2 C32, TP4 C16)

metricDefinitions.meanInteractivity: 1 / mean TPOT, output tok/s/user; TPOT = (E2E - TTFT) / (output tokens - 1) per request
metricDefinitions.totalThroughput: (input + output tokens) / benchmark duration, tok/s across all allocated GPUs; input counts the cached prefix
metricDefinitions.ttft_e2e: mean_ttft_s and mean_e2el_s are request means in seconds

limitations: One measurement window per point. 139 points come from runs whose warm-up repeated the first measured request; 13 points whose original window had an AITER JIT compile stall were replaced by reruns with independent warm-up requests; 10 points (compile_stall = true) stalled in both runs and keep the window with the shorter engine log gap. Acceptance length varies with prompt content and seed.
